arxiv-2208-07422.title: Deep Unsupervised Domain Adaptation: A Review of Recent Advances and Perspectives
arxiv-2208-07422.creator: Xiaofeng Liu, Chaehwa Yoo, Fangxu Xing, Hyejin Oh, Georges El Fakhri, Je-Won Kang, Jonghye Woo
arxiv-2208-07422.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiaofeng Liu, Chaehwa Yoo, Fangxu Xing, Hyejin Oh, Georges El Fakhri, Je-Won Kang, Jonghye Woo. Deep learning has become the method of choice to tackle real-world problems in different domains, partly because of its ability to learn from data and achieve impressive performance on a wide range of applications. However, its success usually relies on two assumptions: (i) vast troves of labeled datasets are required for accurate model fitting, and (ii) training and testing data are independent and identically distributed.

arxiv-2212-01630.title: On the rate of convergence of the shape of Young diagrams associated with random words
arxiv-2212-01630.creator: Clément Deslandes, Christian Houdré
arxiv-2212-01630.description: Abstract We revisit, beyond the uniform case, some aspects of the convergence of the cumulative shape of the RSK Young diagrams associated with random words, obtaining rates of convergence in Kolmogorov’s distance. Since the length of the top row of the diagrams is the length of the longest increasing subsequences of the word, a corresponding rate result follows.

arxiv-2212-07184.title: Measurements of Z ​ γ + Z\gamma+ jets differential cross sections in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2212-07184.description: Abstract Differential cross-section measurements of Z ​ γ Z\gamma production in association with hadronic jets are presented, using the full 139 fb -1 dataset of s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV proton–proton collisions collected by the ATLAS detector during Run 2 of the LHC.

arxiv-2305-11317.title: Collaborative Generative AI: Integrating GPT- k k for Efficient Editing in Text-to-Image Generation
arxiv-2305-11317.creator: Wanrong Zhu, Xinyi Wang, Yujie Lu, Tsu-Jui Fu, Xin Eric Wang, Miguel Eckstein, William Yang Wang
arxiv-2305-11317.description: Abstract The field of text-to-image (T2I) generation has garnered significant attention both within the research community and among everyday users. Despite the advancements of T2I models, a common issue encountered by users is the need for repetitive editing of input prompts in order to receive a satisfactory image, which is time-consuming and labor-intensive.

arxiv-2403-05344.title: Federated Learning Method for Preserving Privacy in Face Recognition System
arxiv-2403-05344.creator: Enoch Solomon, Abraham Woubie
arxiv-2403-05344.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Enoch Solomon, Abraham Woubie. The state-of-the-art face recognition systems are typically trained on a single computer, utilizing extensive image datasets collected from various number of users. However, these datasets often contain sensitive personal information that users may hesitate to disclose. To address potential privacy concerns, we explore the application of federated learning, both with and without secure aggregators, in the context of both supervised and unsupervised face recognition systems.

arxiv-2404-19724.title: Sound and Complete Proof Rules for Probabilistic Termination
arxiv-2404-19724.creator: Rupak Majumdar, V. R. Sathiyanarayana
arxiv-2404-19724.description: Abstract . Deciding termination is a fundamental problem in the analysis of probabilistic imperative programs. We consider the qualitative and quantitative probabilistic termination problems for an imperative programming model with discrete probabilistic choice and demonic bounded nondeterminism. The qualitative question asks if the program terminates almost-surely, no matter how nondeterminism is resolved.

arxiv-2405-00868.title: The Furstenberg-Sárközy theorem for polynomials in one or more prime variables
arxiv-2405-00868.creator: John R. Doyle Alex Rice
arxiv-2405-00868.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by John R. Doyle Alex Rice. We establish upper bounds on the size of the largest subset of { 1 , 2 , … , N } \{1,2,\dots,N\} lacking nonzero differences of the form h ⁡ ( p 1 , … , p ℓ ) h(p_{1},\dots,p_{\ell}) , where h ∈ ℤ ⁡ [ x 1 , … , x ℓ ] h\in\mathbb{Z}[x_{1},\dots,x_{\ell}] is a fixed polynomial satisfying appropriate conditions and p 1 , … , p ℓ p_{1},\dots,p_{\ell} are prime.

arxiv-2407-13156.title: Quantum Key Distribution Routing Protocol in Quantum Networks: Overview and Challenges
arxiv-2407-13156.creator: Pankaj Kumar, Student Member, IEEE , Neel Kanth Kundu, Member, IEEE , and Binayak Kar, Member, IEEE
arxiv-2407-13156.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Pankaj Kumar, Student Member, IEEE , Neel Kanth Kundu, Member, IEEE , and Binayak Kar, Member, IEEE. The use of quantum cryptography in everyday applications has gained attention in both industrial and academic fields. Due to advancements in quantum electronics, practical quantum devices are already available in the market, and ready for wider use. Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) is a crucial aspect of quantum cryptography, which involves generating and distributing symmetric cryptographic keys between geographically separated users using principles of quantum physics.

arxiv-2411-06609.title: On the optimal choice of the illumination function in photoacoustic tomography Thanks: This research was funded in part by the Austrian Science Fund (FWF) [10.55776/DOC78] Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author: Barbara Kaltenbacher
arxiv-2411-06609.description: Abstract . This work studies the inverse problem of photoacoustic tomography (more precisely, the acoustic subproblem) as the identification of a space-dependent source parameter. The model consists of a wave equation involving a time-fractional damping term to account for power law frequency dependence of the attenuation, as relevant in ultrasonics.

arxiv-2506-06781.title: Morse theory and moduli spaces of self-avoiding polygonal linkages
arxiv-2506-06781.creator: Te Ba, Ze Zhou
arxiv-2506-06781.description: Abstract . We prove that a smooth d d -manifold M M is diffeomorphic to ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} if it admits a Lyapunov-Reeb function, i.e., a smooth map f : M → ℝ f:M\to\mathbb{R} that is proper, lower-bounded, and has a unique critical point.

arxiv-2506-18409.title: On the Maximization of Real Sequences
arxiv-2506-18409.creator: Assalé Adjé
arxiv-2506-18409.description: Abstract In this paper, we study a maximization problem on real sequences. More precisely, for a given sequence, we are interesting in computing the supremum of the sequence and an index for which the associated term is maximal. We propose a general methodology to solve this maximization problem.

arxiv-2510-26427.title: On a semi-discrete model of Maxwell’s equations in three and two dimensions
arxiv-2510-26427.creator: Volodymyr Sushch
arxiv-2510-26427.description: Abstract In this paper, we develop a geometric, structure-preserving semi-discrete formulation of Maxwell’s equations in both three- and two-dimensional settings within the framework of discrete exterior calculus. This approach preserves the intrinsic geometric and topological structures of the continuous theory while providing a consistent spatial discretization.

arxiv-2602-16404.title: A Class of algebras admitting infinitely many norm topologies
arxiv-2602-16404.creator: J. G. Patel*
arxiv-2602-16404.description: Abstract . Let 𝒜 \mathcal{A} be an algebra, and let 𝒜 2 = \mathcal{A}^{2}= span { a b : a , b ∈ 𝒜 } \{ab:a,b\in\mathcal{A}\} be a subalgebra of 𝒜 \mathcal{A} . In this paper, we prove that if 𝒜 2 \mathcal{A}^{2} has infinite codimension in 𝒜 \mathcal{A} iff 𝒜 \mathcal{A} has discontinuous square annihilation property (DSAP).

pmc-12447620.title: Relationship between future time perspective and academic self-efficacy: the chain mediating roles of personal growth initiative and learning engagement
pmc-12447620.creator: Xiao-Yan Zhu, Shi-Min Chen, Hang Lyu
pmc-12447620.description: BackgroundAcademic self-efficacy is a key predictor of academic performance. As college students mature, they increasingly focus on their future prospects. This study intended to further examine the relationship between college students’ future time perspective (FTP) and academic self-efficacy (ASE) by introducing personal growth initiative (PGI) and learning engagement (LE) as two mediators from the perspective of positive psychology.

pmc-12556746.title: Determining the effects of hyperthermia on the tumor and acute normal tissue response of FLASH radiation

pmc-12556746.description: IntroductionThere is limited indication of how hyperthermia would influence the unique proposition of FLASH radiation – its ability to maintain comparable tumor response while offering protection to normal tissues. Hence, this study was designed to investigate the potential of combining FLASH radiation with hyperthermia.

pmc-12589632.creator: Ricarda Lehmitz, Karin Hohberg, Martin Husemann, Ralph S. Peters, Nicole Scheunemann, Miklós Bálint, Michael Balke, Judith Bieberich, Iliana Bista, Thomas Borsch, Sarah J. pmc-12589632.description: Biodiversity knowledge, from genes to ecosystems, is crucial for addressing the biodiversity crisis. However, even in well-explored countries like Germany, much biodiversity remains unknown. Therefore, several research institutions are joining forces to conduct a comprehensive biodiversity inventory, combining broad taxonomic expertise with advanced technologies.

pmc-13101637.title: Association of front-of-package warning label perceptions with Mediterranean diet adherence after bariatric surgery
pmc-13101637.creator: Sila Maribel Laboriano Milián, Lesly Pamela Palomino Ruiz, Wilter C Morales-García, Yaquelin E Calizaya-Milla
pmc-13101637.description: BackgroundFront-of-package (FOP) warning labels are intended to support healthier food choices; however, evidence on how patients perceive these warnings after bariatric surgery and how such perceptions relate to dietary quality is limited. We examined the association between perceptions of FOP warning labels and Mediterranean diet (MedDiet) adherence among adults after bariatric surgery in Lima, Peru.
